chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha', who said:
Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام said to me: Repetition is required regarding the first two rak'ahs, and inadvertence concerns the last two rak'ahs.

key_terms.السَّهْوُ: inadvertence, forgetfulness, or mistake in prayer
key_terms.الْآخِرَتَيْنِ: the final two units of the prayer
key_terms.الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ: the first two units of the prayer
key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition or performance again of the prayer portion in question

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on forgetfulness in the first two and last two rak'ahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling about doubt or inadvertence in salat (prayer), distinguishing between the first two rak'ahs and the last two. It indicates that the first two rak'ahs require repetition, while inadvertence in the final two rak'ahs is treated differently within prayer law.
